seo.title: Removal of Datacrédito reports | Orión Lex
seo.description: Have you been reported to Datacrédito? We review your case under the law to determine whether the report can be corrected or removed. Online service throughout Colombia.

image.alt: Person reviewing a credit history report with charts using a pen

cta.label: Review my report
cta.message: Hello, I would like to review my Datacrédito report.

hero.lead: Have you been reported to Datacrédito?
paragraphs: Even a small debt can affect your credit history. And paying it does not always remove the report right away: negative information can remain for up to twice the time the debt was overdue, with a maximum of four years after payment.
hero.emphasis: At ORIÓN LEX we review your case under the law to determine whether the report can be corrected or removed.

cases.title: When should you have your case reviewed?
items: You already paid and the report is still there.
You do not recognize the debt or the amount reported.
You did not receive notice before the report.
You believe the retention period has ended.

steps.title: Diagnosis
steps.description: We review your credit history and the documents of the obligation.

steps.title: Advice
steps.description: We explain what we found and the possible solutions for your case.

steps.title: Legal action
steps.description: We file the claims and carry out the applicable legal actions.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.description: We inform you of the result and deliver the actions taken.

items.question: Can you guarantee that my report will be removed?
items.answer: Our success rate is 90% of the cases our firm takes on.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: The process can take between 15 and 90 days.

items.question: Do you work nationwide?
items.answer: Yes. We work online throughout Colombia and with people abroad whose matters are subject to Colombian law.

items.question: How do I know who I am hiring?
items.answer: Before hiring us you can review the details of ORIÓN LEX S.A.S., the professional who will handle your case and the terms of the service.

items.question: Can I request removal even if I still owe money?
items.answer: Yes, but removing the record does not cancel the debt.

closing.title: Let's review your report
closing.text: Write to us on WhatsApp and we will tell you whether there is a legal way to correct or remove your report.
closing.coverage: We work online throughout Colombia and with people abroad whose matters are subject to Colombian law.
